name: Noah Gugnon
summary: A 25-year-old French lightweight (10-2), formerly of Bellator and ARES FC, with every win by stoppage: on a six-fight finishing streak in our data, including a 1:21 rear-naked choke of Milos Janicic in his UFC debut. There is little UFC footage, and he has only ever seen a third round once, in a decision loss.

how_they_fight.Striking: Heavy leg kicks and ground strikes: Janicic could not put weight on his leg after a few low kicks, and per Heavy he finished Adrian Prisceanu with elbows. Six KO/TKO wins in our data, all in round one or two.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Finishes when people go down: he followed Janicic to the mat, took the back, put the hooks in and choked him out. Four submission wins (rounds one and two). Heavy describes his ground game as solid.
how_they_fight.Defense: Largely untested at this level. He was stopped in round two by Mark Ewen at Bellator 299 (2023, as a big underdog) and lost a decision to Samvel Vardanyan in 2024, back-to-back losses after a 4-0 start.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: An early finisher: in our data seven of his ten wins came in round one and three in round two; he has never won in round three or on the cards. His only 15-minute fight was the loss to Vardanyan. Stopped once (round two, Ewen). Late-round cardio against a durable opponent is the open question.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Ruthless follow-up when he hurts someone, but there is almost no tape of him under sustained pressure or behind on the cards. Took the Janicic bout on short notice per Heavy.

patterns: All ten wins by finish, seven in round one
Leg kicks to compromise the base, then pounce
concerns: Unproven over three rounds; 0-1 in decisions
Two losses in 2023-24 to Bellator/regional opponents, one by round-two KO
One UFC fight, under 90 seconds long
Quick turnaround: under three months since his debut
keys_to_beat: Survive round one and drag him into rounds two and three
Check the leg kicks and stay on your feet
Don't give up the back in scrambles
Make him fight from behind; there is no tape of him rallying after losing early rounds

news.text: Made weight at the official weigh-ins: 156 lb (Steele 156).
Sherdog preview: +130 underdog (Steele -155); credits his power but picks Steele by first-round submission.
Booked against Kody Steele at lightweight on the UFC 333 prelims, his second UFC fight.
UFC debut: rear-naked choke of fellow newcomer Milos Janicic at 1:21 of round one at UFC Belgrade.
